name: Kodoku ni Kiku Yuri
source:
She gave her love, and tenderness.
First with a kiss...

It was first year in high school. The budding of summer.
Fusa Konno met a shut-in girl named Seri.
Persecuted by her yearning eyes, her heart opened...
